item.title: Tips to prevent encounters, conflict with coyotes as mating season begins
item.description: As Virginians may see and hear coyotes more frequently this time of year, officials are sharing several tips to prevent conflict with the animals.

item.title: Virginia Tech experts weigh in on social media addiction lawsuits
item.description: Experts from Virginia Tech University discussed the impacts of ongoing lawsuits aiming to hold major social media companies accountable for making their products addictive to children.

item.title: Former Virginia Attorney General's Office employee sues Miyares, alleging wrongful firing after raising concerns about possible conflict of interest
item.description: A former Virginia Attorney General's Office employee filed a lawsuit on Thursday against former Attorney General Jason Miyares, among other previous office leaders, due to allegations of wrongful termination after she spoke out about a payment she alleged was a conflict of interest.

item.description: Three Central Virginia farms and agricultural businesses are among those receiving over $4.9 million in state grants aimed at strengthening food systems across the commonwealth.

item.title: Road closures in Henrico County for sewer installation and repair
item.description: Henrico County has announced that there will be road closures starting Monday, Feb. 16, and Tuesday, Feb. 17, for sewer installation and repair.

item.title: Richmond floral boutique owner aids homeless with Valentine's pop-up shop
item.description: The owner of the floral boutique, Flowers by Maryjane, is sharing the love with those who need it most this Valentine's Day.

item.title: Vehicle fire safety tips from the U.S. Fire Administration after incident in Richmond
item.description: Tips from the U.S. Fire Administration on what to do if a vehicle catches fire, shared after an incident in Richmond on Saturday night.

item.title: Richmond immigration attorney debunks misinformation on ICE, speaks on activity in Virginia
item.description: A Richmond immigration attorney is breaking down what you need to know about federal immigration enforcement in Virginia, from debunking misinformation to explaining what rights you have when you interact with U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE).
